nodes.name: Watch the collector mailbox
nodes.notes:
IMAP with an app password, not the Gmail OAuth trigger.

gmail.readonly is a RESTRICTED scope: an External OAuth app needs Google verification plus an annual third-party CASA security assessment, and an app left in Testing mode expires its refresh token every 7 days. One app password on one collector mailbox avoids all of it.

format=resolved is required. The simple form drops attachments and the Message-ID, and Message-ID is what /ingest deduplicates on -- which matters here because five mailboxes forward into this one, so the same supplier email genuinely does arrive twice.

nodes.name: Build the payload
nodes.notes:
Everything n8n decides is here, in one readable place, rather than spread across a dozen nodes nobody can diff.

Note what is NOT here any more: spreadsheet conversion. The backend now accepts content_base64 and reads workbooks with read_spreadsheet, the same function the sample corpus uses. The old Extract-From-File node also had a real bug -- it pooled every sheet row in the execution, so two emails arriving in one poll each received the other's rows.

nodes.name: POST /ingest
nodes.notes:
Retries on 5xx because the pipeline returns 500 for an unexpected failure and those are usually transient. It does NOT retry a 4xx: a malformed payload will be just as malformed the third time.

A retry that actually succeeded the first time is harmless -- the backend deduplicates on message_id.
